'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**The [[Houthis]] claim to have shot down a [[United States]] [[MQ-9 Reaper]] drone in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/houthis-claim-shoot-down-us-mq9-reaper-drone-red-sea (Fox News)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah clashes]]
**Israeli airstrikes target Hezbollah sites in [[Marwahin]], [[Sidon]], [[Meiss El Jabal]] and [[al-Adisa]] in [[southern Lebanon]] in response to the launch of a [[UAV]] toward the [[Lower Galilee]].[https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-787760 (Jerusalem Post)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Brazil–Israel relations]]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Israel)|Israeli Foreign Minister]] [[Israel Katz]] says that [[President of Brazil|Brazilian president]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] is a ''[[persona non grata]]'' in [[Israel]] until he retracts his comments [[Holocaust trivialization#Israeli–Palestinian conflict|comparing]] the war between Israel and [[Hamas]] to the [[Holocaust]]. In response, [[Brazil]] recalls its ambassador to Israel. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/brazils-lula-not-welcome-israel-israels-foreign-minister-says-2024-02-19/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/brazil-president-recalls-ambassador-israel-talks-local-media-2024-02-19/ (Reuters 2)]
